messages:
harper: Quick follow-up from the postmortem #521 — we need concrete test artifacts and owners so this doesn't recur. I sketched a minimal plan below.

harper: Scope: 1) one regression suite for customer-facing failures, 2) two curated prompt sets (billing + safety edge cases), 3) short burst load test for spikes, 4) small chaos drill in staging. Link all PRs to #521.

morgan: I'll own the postmortem link + docs. Can we pick owners for each artifact? Deadline: draft PRs by Tue EOD.

devin: I can take the regression suite. Will add token-diff checks, exact-match critical prompts, and latency assertions. Plan to run across variants v1.4 and v1.4-quant. Target: draft PR Mon.

alejandra: I'll assemble the two prompt sets from the incident logs and sanitize PII. Format will include tags and repro notes. PR Tue.

sai: I'll build a short load harness: 2 minute burst, ramp to 200 qps, collect p50/p95/p99 and token-cost. Add as nightly optional CI job. Draft today.

harper: Chaos drill ops: propose Wed 09:00 UTC, 30m window, staging only. Scope: evict one GPU pod and restart a control-plane replica. ops-bot create invite.

ops-bot: Chaos drill scheduled: Wed 09:00 UTC (30m). Invite sent to eng-sre, eng-platform, oncall. Runbook: https://go/drills/521. Reminder 24h prior. :robot_face:

morgan: Also add a short prefix-cache probe to nightly evals (we saw tokenizer cold-start spikes). Script: `infra/evals/prefix_probe.py --model v1.4`.

devin: For GH actions I'll add a matrix: variants: ["v1.4","v1.4-quant"] and a job `regression` that runs `pytest tests/regression/test_incident_521.py::test_critical_flow`.

alejandra: I'll include a small anonymizer step: `python infra/tools/anonymize.py --in logs.json --out sanitized.json` before committing prompt sets.

sai: I'll open a draft load-job PR with metrics export to Prometheus/Datadog and a dashboard link.

morgan: Ownership recap:
- regression suite: devin
- prompt sets + anonymizer: alejandra
- load burst + CI job: sai
- chaos drill coordination: harper + ops-bot
- postmortem linking/docs: morgan

harper: Please post PR links to #521 when ready. We'll do a 15m sync after the drill to confirm results and decide if any tests should be promoted to gating.

devin: ack.

alejandra: ack.

sai: ack.

ops-bot: Reminder will be sent 24h before drill.
